title: Umbral Spire - First True Dawn
_note: CLIMAX triumphant-resolve variant - the Keystar-relight resolution as its own cue: dark turns to dawn, Keylumen radiant, the Skyweave Crown completing overhead. The emotional peak setting up the Dawnstead epilogue. snes era (8 voices, chords, generous reverb). 120 BPM, 4/4, radiant A MAJOR. 24-bar loop. Vesper motif TOTAL PAYOFF - cosy at the hub, broken at Coldfog, withheld at the Penumbra, minor at the Spire, now stated WHOLE in triumphant A major, fully harmonised: E4->A4->B4 lift ... C#5->B4->A4 settle home. lead=pulse25 singing the motif complete and soaring. counter-lead=a harmonising second line. harmony=lush warm chords + harp-like pluck arpeggio + swelling pad, generous reverb. bass=warm, full, grounded. drums=triumphant, big but joyful, a final crash. Last bar E(V) -> resolves to A bar 1.

tracks._note: The Vesper motif WHOLE in triumphant A major. Bars 1-2 the lift E4->A4->B4, bars 3-4 the settle C#5->B4->A4. Soaring, complete.
